concepts.title: The Powder Bodybuilders Don't Talk About
concepts.desc: A locker-room-energy talking head where a gym guy reveals the one powder serious lifters take but never post about. He walks through why it's different from his protein stack — one ingredient, gut-level recovery — and dares the viewer to look it up.
narrative: Open with him mid-reveal, holding the jar low like it's contraband — he checks over his shoulder, then leans in.
Cut to him mixing one scoop into water while he explains the mechanism: gut barrier first, everything else follows — recovery, energy, fewer sick days.
Close with the empty glass, the jar face-up to camera, and the line 'Now you know. 30% off your first order — link below.'
design: Talking head with punch-ins on the jar and the mix — locker-room confessional energy, natural light
Static native subtitles, 1–2 words max per line, bold keyword highlights on 'one ingredient' and 'gut barrier'
Duration: 20–25s · the colostrum brand Partner badge + FDA disclaimer on close
hooks: The strongest guys at my gym all take this and none of them post about it.
My protein shake has 6 ingredients. My recovery has one.
A pediatric neurologist made the one supplement bodybuilders actually gatekeep.
